cd /tmp/obench-cell-huoa6b85/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_e4yyoebh; rm -rf /tmp/out_test*; python convert_masks.py /tmp/msam/mobile_sam.pt /tmp/out_test demo_rgb.png demo_metadata.csv 2>&1 | tail -1; python convert_masks.py --weights_path /tmp/msam/mobile_sam.pt --output_path /tmp/out_test2/x.csv --rgb_path demo_rgb.png --csv_path demo_metadata.csv 2>&1 | tail -1
cat > /tmp/validate.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2, sys
a=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv'); b=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
assert list(a.columns)==list(b.columns) and len(a)==len(b)
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W=img.shape[:2]
P=lambda s:[int(float(v)) for v in str(s).split(',')]
ms=[];rect=0;ious=[]
for (_,ra),(_,r) in zip(a.iterrows(),b.iterrows()):
    xs,ys=P(r.coords_x),P(r.coords_y)
    if len(set(xs))<=2 and len(set(ys))<=2: rect+=1
    assert (min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys))==(r.xmin,r.xmax,r.ymin,r.ymax)
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.array(list(zip(xs,ys)),np.int32)],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m,connectivity=4); assert n==2,(r.iloc[0],n)
    ms.append(m)
    if ra.type=='polyline':
        o=np.zeros_like(m); cv2.fillPoly(o,[np.array(list(zip(P(ra.coords_x),P(ra.coords_y))),np.int32)],1)
        ious.append((m&o).sum()/(m|o).sum())
    cv2.polylines(img,[np.array(list(zip(xs,ys)),np.int32)],True,(0,255,0) if ra.type=='polyline' else (0,0,255),1)
s=np.sum(ms,0); print('rects',rect,'overlap px',(s>1).sum(),'mean IoU vs orig polylines %.3f'%np.mean(ious), 'min %.3f'%min(ious))
assert (b.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y'])==a.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y'])).all().all()
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',cv2.resize(img,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)); print('OK')
EOF
python /tmp/validate.py /tmp/out_test/demo_metadata.csv; python /tmp/validate.py /tmp/out_test2/x.csv
